title: DAPI: Domain Adaptive Toxicity Probe Vector Intervention for Fine-Grained Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Automated scoring of generated text continuations from the REALTOXICITYPROMPTS dataset using the Perspective API, supplemented by expert human evaluation comparing the toxicity and naturalness of outputs.
Category-wise evaluation of generated text using the Perspective API to assess the model's ability to mitigate toxicity specifically for the 'identity-attack' category.
